notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact card in hand.
description:
Activate Metalworker by tapping it, revealing at least one artifact card from your hand and adding at least {C}{C}.
Activate Voltaic Key by paying {1} and tapping it, targeting Metalworker.
Ertha Jo's second ability triggers, copying Voltaic Key's ability, targeting Voltaic Key.
Resolve both Voltaic Key abilities, untapping it and Metalworker.
Repeat.
